prompt: Tests in this repo fail: run go test ./... and you'll see coupon sync stops working after the first API error. Find the bug(s) in sync.go and fix them so all tests pass. You must NOT modify sync_test.go or api.go — fix the logic in sync.go only. Behavior spec: SyncPending pushes every pending coupon to the API; a coupon that fails stays pending and is retried on the next SyncPending call; a success marks it synced; concurrent SyncPending calls must not run simultaneously (second call returns ErrSyncInFlight) but a finished or failed sync must always release the lock.
title: Stuck Sync-Lock Debugging
goal: Debug a coupon syncer where one API failure permanently wedges the in-flight lock and aborts the whole batch. Fix sync.go only; tests are read-only.
signal: Root-cause debugging, not feature writing: two interacting bugs (early return skips lock release, one bad coupon halts the batch) mirror a real cart gift-sync incident. Hidden concurrency tests catch superficial fixes.
